title: Belonging is not a private possession
summary: Belonging is received from the One who holds everyone together. Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
takeaway: Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
lifeApplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, speak to the Lord as one already being held.

source.shortMeaning: Belonging is received from the One who holds everyone together.
source.lifeApplication: When worth feels scarce, remember that belonging is not yours to ration.

evidence.coreClaim: Belonging is received from the One who holds everyone together.
evidence.turn: Hold onto this: belonging is received from the One who holds everyone.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, speak to the Lord as one already being held.
